Name: Healthcare, Consumer & Specialty Products
Interpretation: Generally greatest ability to substitute, redesign, or pass costs through.

Name: Automotive & Transportation
Interpretation: Some substitution and redesign possible over several years.

Name: Electronics & Semiconductors
Interpretation: Highly dependent on specific materials and performance characteristics.

Name: Construction & Infrastructure
Interpretation: Material substitution is often possible, though slowly.

Name: Energy & Power Generation
Interpretation: Long-lived assets with limited short-term substitution options.

Name: Aerospace, Defense, and Space
Interpretation: Very inelastic. Certification and safety requirements make substitution difficult.

Name: Chemicals, Materials & Industrial Processing
Interpretation: Moderate ability to reformulate processes and switch feedstocks.

Name: Clean Energy & Electrification
Interpretation: Technology pathways are constrained by mineral requirements and policy targets.

Name: Agriculture & Fertilizers
Interpretation: Food demand ultimately constrains substitution. Farmers can defer but not eliminate inputs.
